Birth.BornCity: A village in the lands of the Arverni

Naked: Prefers going barefoot to feel the life of the plants she seeks.
Story: The five sisters are survivors of a Roman massacre in their Gallic village. Having lost their family and people, they fled into the forests. They have sworn a vow of celibacy, promising not to rest or know peace until Julius Caesar, the man responsible for their people's suffering, is dead. They use their unique combat skills to survive and fight back against the Roman invaders.

BodyMarks.Name: Freckles
BodyMarks.Description: Faint freckles scattered like dust across her entire face.

Details.Name: Hair
Descriptions: Strawberry-blonde hair, long and often containing twigs or leaves from her foraging.

Details.Name: Body
Descriptions: Fair skin that is surprisingly resistant to scratches from her work.

Talents: Can identify any plant in the forest and its uses.
Advantages: Deep knowledge of flora and fauna
Disadvantages: Physically the weakest of the sisters

Description: A sturdy oak staff used for walking and defense
A small knife for gathering herbs
A large leather satchel filled with medicinal herbs, bandages, and poultices

Notes: The youngest, she is the heart of the group, patching up their wounds and keeping hope alive.
